text:
Date: Announced on 14 March at the prize's annual ceremony.
Named person: Ilse Marchetti-Brandt, chair of the Calder Vane Prize jury, delivered the announcement.
Figure: The award carries a purse of 250,000 credits.
Source event: The jury's published citation, "Statement of the 2025 Architecture Jury," read at the ceremony in Veldmark Hall.
